review_notes: I read the whole file and the upstream lemma amnr_flowAverageA0Plus_mixed_of_flow_bounds in FlowAverageSourceBounds.lean. I compared the proofs against each other. The only repeated block that is more than routine boilerplate is the uniform A0Plus flow-average bound, which is proved twice inline. The repeated hS/hH nonnegativity facts and positivity side lemmas are short and I did not report them. The big hHbound/hPbound blocks are used only once. I could not compile anything. One uncertainty: the second copy has no `hChat` in context, whereas the first has it. The shared lemma should include `hChat` (it is derived from I.one_le_Chat in both theorems) so that `gcongr` can discharge its nonnegativity side goal.

findings.problem: Two theorems each re-derive the same uniform bound |amnrWord b v (amnrFlowAverageA0Plus I hΦ m j k i p) y| ≤ uniFlowAvgA0Plus β C₀ * amnrWeight S H v for mixed words v. Each one: (1) specialises amnr_flowAverageA0Plus_mixed_of_flow_bounds to the uniform flow-gradient bound (havgGen at 228 / hAplusGen at 284); (2) gets the raw bound with the constant 3 * 2^N * I.Chat * (2^N * X * X); (3) proves hcoeff by `unfold uniFlowAvgA0Plus; gcongr` using I.Chat ≤ C₀; (4) multiplies by amnrWeight_nonneg, which needs hS and hH. The blocks at lines 228-241 and 284 + 316-328 are the same argument with renamed variables, and each carries its own copy of the hS/hH setup. The file already does this for the sibling quantity: `uni_flowAverage_mixed_bounds` exists as a standalone lemma for uniFlowAvg. The A0Plus analogue is inlined twice instead.
findings.proposed_change:
Add, next to uni_flowAverage_mixed_bounds, a lemma with the same hypotheses (I, hz, hh, hΦ, hreg):

theorem uni_flowAverageA0Plus_mixed_bounds ... : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → ∀ j k i p v, IsAmnrMixedWord v → amnrBudget v ≤ AVenhance.Nstar β → ∀ y, |amnrWord (fun y => AVenhance.streamVel (Φ (m - 1)) y.1 y.2) v (amnrFlowAverageA0Plus I hΦ m j k i p) y| ≤ uniFlowAvgA0Plus β C₀ * amnrWeight (AVenhance.epsilon β I.Λ (m - 1) ^ (-(1 + AVenhance.gamma β / 2))) (AVenhance.tauP β I.Λ m)⁻¹ v.

Proof sketch: take hX := uniFlowGrad_nonneg β C₀, hflow := uni_flowGrad_mixed_bounds I hz hh hΦ hreg and hChat : 0 ≤ I.Chat (from I.one_le_Chat). Then hraw := amnr_flowAverageA0Plus_mixed_of_flow_bounds I hΦ hX hflow m hm j k i p v hv hvb y. Next, hcoeff by `unfold uniFlowAvgA0Plus; gcongr`. Weight nonnegativity comes from amnrWeight_nonneg with Real.rpow_nonneg (epsilon_pos ..).le and inv_nonneg.mpr (tauP_pos ..).le, exactly as in uni_flowAverage_mixed_bounds. Finish with hraw.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoeff hW).

Use 1 (seed): `havgBound` becomes `fun v hv hvb y _ => uni_flowAverageA0Plus_mixed_bounds I hz hh hΦ hreg m hm j k i p v hv hvb y`, passed to amnrLMN_mul_mixed_le. The hAvgConst, hMem and hSeedConst steps are unchanged.
Use 2 (temperature): `hAplusBound a p v hv y := uni_flowAverageA0Plus_mixed_bounds I hz hh hΦ hreg m hm a p i j v (hw.sublist hv) ((amnrBudget_sublist hv).trans hbudget) y`. The local hAplusGen and hcoeff go away.

Both theorems already import the same modules and have the same hypotheses, so no import changes are needed.
findings.benefit: The A0Plus analogue then matches the existing uni_flowAverage_mixed_bounds. It removes about 25 duplicated lines. It also leaves a single place to change if the constant uniFlowAvgA0Plus or the upstream constant 3 * 2^N * Chat * (2^N * X * X) changes. Before this change the two copies had to be kept in sync by hand. The two large downstream proofs get shorter and focus on their own steps.
